value.handoff:
All four findings still failed on base f9244a8 (nojs.spec.ts: 4 failed, 63 passed). Each regression test was red with the finding's observed value, and the final build is green: nojs.spec.ts 72 passed; a11y, T10, T11, M6, M7 and draw-time specs all pass; size has 0 routes over budget, with /tools/geometry/ at 89.8 of 90 kB. The base on this machine measured 89.7, not 89.2, so this branch adds 0.1 kB. Causes: - P4-MERGE-01: T11's Average tab drew no board. It now draws the same big-board panel with its orbit overlay, display only (no node can act). - P4-MERGE-02: T10's build-time stand-in for Predict.svelte put the answer in a bare

. It now uses .answer-text and also has the empty predictResult line. That missing line showed up as a further failure on M7 b4 once root 0 passed, and it has its own sibling test. - P4-MERGE-03: at build time T10 computed its orbit instead of reading the data file the browser loads, and it hid the source until hydration. t10/snapshot.ts now reads site/public/presets/T10/ through an SSR-only import.meta.glob and runs the browser's own loadPlan. A configuration that would wait for 'Draw the orbit' also starts waiting on the server. - P4-MERGE-04: measured times now carry data-measured. The stateHooks rule in nojs.spec.ts lists such an output as 'name (measured)', so the element is still required on both sides. All changed files are in the site area (tools, draw/DrawTimeProbe, site tests). None are in another cluster's engine or library files. The only test change outside the new regression tests is that rule, plus one T10.test.ts regex made stricter to require .answer-text. No finding needs a decision.

deviations.what: site/src/lib/a11y.ts and site/src/components/board/BoardEditor.svelte are shared files. a11y.ts is used by every tool that announces moves, and BoardEditor is used by T4 and T16.
deviations.why: These files hold the causes. The only change in a11y.ts is that an empty change list leaves out the clause. BoardEditor only adds a disabled option when the held count is above 4.

value.handoff: All three findings are fixed, along with the two residuals. Each fix has a regression test that failed at base f9244a8 and passes now; this list holds every red and green run. P3-RT-10-05: T9's return counts are now toNumbers(transposeBoard(board), coroot(board, end)), built only from existing CONTRACTS 2.4 exports, so no engine export was added. The finding's own fix was right. recipeMatrix was used only by tests, so it moved unchanged out of t09/kostant.ts into site/tests/unit/tools/T09.test.ts, and no T9 source reads board.cartan any more. P3-RT-05-08: changedOnly now leaves out the empty clause ('Fired node 3. Move 1.'), and every other A-4 sentence is unchanged. T11 still says '... Nothing changed. Move k.', as decisions/P4-A4.md records, so the site has two readings and the owner should pick one. P3-RT-05-10: T7's Letters panel now uses NUMBERS_ICON and --accent-numbers. T16 residual: the road selects show a held count above 4 as a disabled option and still offer only 0 to 4. Export, the refused import and the round trip after lowering are covered by the test and described in the fragment. Shared files changed outside the T-tool areas are site/src/lib/a11y.ts and site/src/components/board/BoardEditor.svelte; MERGE should check them for conflicts with other fixers. Open questions, not fixed here: labels.indexOf still converts labels to positions in other places: T01GameBoard.svelte 315 and 662, T03FormFinder.svelte 304 and 429, T04ClassificationLab.svelte 307, T05NumbersGameLab.svelte 315, 330 and 866, t05/dimension.ts 55 and 63, T15AffinePlayground.svelte 705, T16Sandbox.svelte 536, BoardEditor.svelte 198, board/keyboard.ts 45, draw/layouts.ts 87 and lib/urlCodec.ts 222. These are E-7 rule breaks that need their own finding. While the other direction holds more than 4, the editor refuses a change to the first direction because setRoads checks both counts. The select then returns to the held count, so the reader must lower the held count first. The 4 nojs failures seen (m6, m7, tools/geometry) are the deferred P4-MERGE-01 to 04 and are not caused by this branch.
